from.place: Proof, first paragraph: "Right associativity and the compatibility of the two actions follow from naturality of beta and the hexagon identities".

title: The two tensor-product formulas for a braiding
statement:
Let $(\mathcal C,\otimes,\mathbf 1)$ be a monoidal category with associator $\alpha_{X,Y,Z}:(X\otimes Y)\otimes Z\to X\otimes(Y\otimes Z)$ (notation as in [det-def-sfb-ring-object-monoid]) and braiding $\beta$. For all objects $X,Y,Z$,
$$\beta_{X\otimes Y,Z}=\alpha_{Z,X,Y}\circ(\beta_{X,Z}\otimes Y)\circ\alpha_{X,Z,Y}^{-1}\circ(X\otimes\beta_{Y,Z})\circ\alpha_{X,Y,Z},$$
$$\beta_{X,Y\otimes Z}=\alpha_{Y,Z,X}^{-1}\circ(Y\otimes\beta_{X,Z})\circ\alpha_{Y,X,Z}\circ(\beta_{X,Y}\otimes Z)\circ\alpha_{X,Y,Z}^{-1}.$$
An object in a tensor product of morphisms denotes its identity morphism, and composition is read from right to left.
